svg.text: Entity Relationship Diagram (version 2, from the real database)
Replaces Figure 41. 23 tables made by the app: 14 of the 16 tables in version 29 plus 9 new ones (Curriculum Guide and Badge are not
tables). The framework's own tables are left out.
Reading the picture: PK is the primary key; red FK lines name the table they
Lines show the main links only. Other links are written as FK in the table, for
assignments also point to the teacher who owns them, and unlocks and
ratings also point to the parent and learner.
The 100 badge definitions live in a settings file (config/badges.php), not in a
table: the MATATAG codes are kept in settings and on each activity
Supporting tables (no lines drawn; their FK columns name the table they point to)
